problems: The blind guess ('a sailing boat: tall mast, triangular sail, curved hull') matches the intended Lantern Boat. The sail is a four-point belly rather than a pure triangle, but a viewer would still read it as a sail.

All nine key stars sit on their intended parts. Masthead (50191) is at the top of the mast, the sail corners and leeches (48224, 49485, 49712) follow the sail edge, mast foot (50555) sits on the gunwale, hull bottom (50676) is amidships, prow (48774) is raised at the right, and the stern pair (52154, 51523) forms the raised transom at the left.
The figure is the right way up: the mast points up and the hull sits below the sail.
The blue outline is a separate, slightly offset silhouette under the gold lines, so this is not just a copy of the gold lines.
The hull is small and flat relative to the sail and mast, so the boat reads a little less like a curved hull than it could.

Label collisions: 'mast foot on the gunwale' overlaps 'stern post, raised top of th', and 'stern, lower corner of the transom' overlaps 'bottom of the hull, amidships'. Several labels are also clipped at the frame edge ('upper outer corner of the sa', 'lower leech of the sail, whe'). These are presentation issues, not drawing issues.
The pennant at the masthead is not drawn, though the masthead star is placed correctly.
